text: てもちを　せいり　したら　また　きなさい

structure.jp: てもちを　せいり　したら
structure.en: once you've sorted out your party

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'once that has happened'. せいり　したら = 'once you've sorted it out'.

patterns.name: 〜なさい
patterns.explanation: なさい after a verb is a firm but kind order. きなさい = 'come'.
